name: Griffin-14B
attention_variant: hybrid: gated linear recurrences (Hawk) + local attention
notes: Scaled to 14B parameters per the Griffin paper (arXiv:2402.19427). Hawk (pure RNN with gated linear recurrences) exceeds Mamba's reported downstream performance. Griffin (hybrid) matches Llama-2 performance despite 6x fewer training tokens. 'During inference they have lower latency and significantly higher throughput' (qualitative, no numeric ratio). Weights released but no mainstream inference engine ships a Griffin mode. Research-only adoption. [Source fixed from non-existent 'hawk-griffin-gated-linear-recurrence' to 'pap-eff-hawk-griffin'.]
